system.description:
This sleight allows you to reshape your current synthmorph, altering its appearance, proportions, limbs, and physical adaptations. The transformation takes WIL ÷ 5 minutes and is permanent until the sleight is used again.

Machine Chrysalis cannot create or destroy mass. Larger forms require suitable external material, while reducing the morph's size leaves excess components or inert scrap behind. Complex functions still require appropriate materials and components. The sleight affects only your occupied synthmorph and never changes its size category.

You can push this sleight to complete the transformation in seconds (a complex action) and to raise or lower the morph's size category by 1 for the duration of the push. When the push ends, the original mass must flow back: any excess mass is shed as inert scrap, and if not enough mass is available to restore the morph, it takes 2d10 DV.
